item.title: Gordon Monson: BYU absorbs another hit as receiver Parker Kingston sits in a Utah jail cell
item.description: BYU wide receiver Parker Kingston is expected to make his first court appearance on Friday, after being charged with first-degree felony rape this week.

item.description: In naming the second new apostle of his four-month LDS Church presidency, Dallin H. Oaks selected Clark Gilbert, the controversial commissioner of church education.

item.title: How the activists shaping Trump’s anti-transgender policies are influencing Utah’s laws, too
item.description: Out-of-state efforts to shape Utah's laws feature some of the same activists President Donald Trump has relied on to shape his anti-transgender policies.

item.title: Utah caregiver faces 3 murder charges after disabled men were found dead of suspected carbon monoxide poisoning
item.description: A caregiver for people with disabilities has been charged with three counts of murder after three men he left alone in his vehicle were found dead — as prosecutors said he'd previously been reprimanded for leaving clients alone.

item.description: As Colorado River states missed yet another deadline to strike a drought deal, a new forecast showed a grim outlook for the river’s major reservoirs.

item.description: An earthquake shook Salt Lake County on Friday evening — the third felt in the state in less than a month.

item.title: BYU expels receiver Parker Kingston days after arrest on rape charge
item.description: BYU on Friday night expelled wide receiver Parker Kingston, who faces a rape charge in southern Utah.
